parameters.name: placeId
parameters.description: Place ID the banner belongs to.

parameters.name: minLatitude
parameters.description: Minimum latitude of the banner start point bounding box. Only valid in combination with all other bounding box parameters.

parameters.name: maxLatitude
parameters.description: Maximum latitude of the banner start point bounding box. Only valid in combination with all other bounding box parameters.

parameters.name: minLongitude
parameters.description: Minimum longitude of the banner start point bounding box. Only valid in combination with all other bounding box parameters.

parameters.name: maxLongitude
parameters.description: Minimum longitude of the banner start point bounding box. Only valid in combination with all other bounding box parameters.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Query string. The exact search algorithm may change over time.

parameters.name: missionId
parameters.description: ID of a mission that is part of the banner.

parameters.name: onlyOfficialMissions
parameters.description: Only banners with missions created by Niantic.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Agent who created one of the missions of the banner.

parameters.name: listTypes
parameters.description: List(s) the banner is on (requires authentication).

parameters.name: online
parameters.description: Only list online/offline banners.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: orderDirection
parameters.description: Order direction.

parameters.name: proximityLatitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the proximity reference point. Required for orderBy=proximityStartPoint.

parameters.name: proximityLongitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the proximity reference point. Required for orderBy=proximityStartPoint.

parameters.name: minEventTimestamp
parameters.description: Only list events which end after this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: maxEventTimestamp
parameters.description: Only list events which start before this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Include these attributes in the output.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-based offset for searching.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Language priority list for translations.
